methods.H0: Open-Detect Native raw score baseline; A_OD is also saved for Hybrid construction
methods.DES1: frozen DES-v1 raw score reference where available

threshold.rule: Known-Validation P95 independently for every method

candidate_gate.dataset_mean_auroc: mean delta versus H0 >= 0 on both VNAT and USTC-TFC2016
candidate_gate.overall_paired_auroc: pooled primary mean delta versus H0 > 0
candidate_gate.negative_protocol_reduction: at least two fewer negative primary protocols than DES0 versus H0
candidate_gate.hard_regime: for VNAT rsync and scp separately: mean delta versus H0 >= -0.02 and no protocol-class delta < -0.10
candidate_gate.auprc: mean delta versus H0 >= -0.005 on both primary datasets
candidate_gate.ufar: mean delta versus H0 <= +0.01 on both primary datasets
candidate_gate.calibration: no Unknown/Test normalization, threshold, or learned weight

stability_order: largest worst primary protocol delta AUROC
candidate_selection.simplicity_tolerance: among candidates within one negative protocol of the minimum and within 0.01 AUROC of the best worst-case delta, choose H1 before H2 before H3
candidate_selection.final_tiebreaker: largest pooled primary mean delta AUROC

final_gate.HYBRID_CONFIRMED: at least one candidate satisfies every candidate_gate condition
final_gate.HYBRID_PARTIAL: no full candidate, but one candidate has nonnegative mean AUROC on both primary datasets, positive pooled mean AUROC, no systematic AUPRC degradation, and Known-only calibration
final_gate.HYBRID_FAILED: no candidate satisfies the partial condition

forbidden: Unknown/Test percentile fitting or threshold calibration
